title: The Scrutiny & Filing Congestion Loop
path: Scrutiny backlog → Burden on court staff → Speed of verification drops → Time taken in scrutiny rises → Length of scrutiny period rises → Errors in scrutiny rise → Scrutiny backlog rises
mechanism: As the scrutiny backlog piles up, court staff experience severe processing burdens. This delay leads to rushed submissions, higher error rates, and repeated defects/refilings, which further feed back into the pile of pending documents awaiting verification.

title: The Early Settlement & Deterrence Loop
path: Statutory notice → Understanding dishonour notice → Willingness to pay → Use of mediation outside court → Share of dues paid → Perceived accountability
mechanism: Prompt receipt of statutory notices combined with a clear threat of credible legal accountability motivates settlement before trial. When creditors successfully recover funds early via mediation or notice compliance, it reinforces standard, disciplined legal compliance across transactions.

title: Summons Service & Timely Appearance Loop
path: Accuracy of verified address → Summons effectively served → Likelihood accused receives summons → Ease of understanding summons → Perceived accountability → Tendency to evade drops → Chances accused appears rises → Hearings proceed
mechanism: High-accuracy addresses and reliable tracking minimize lost service cycles, removing the excuse of non-service and establishing early procedural momentum.

title: The Adjournment & Caseload Compounding Loop
path: Caseload backlog → Time to next date rises → Gap between hearings rises → Schedulability drops → Adjournment requests rise → Frequency of adjournments rises → Backlog rises
mechanism: When the court docket is overwhelmed, hearings are spaced months apart. Because lawyers handle multiple cases on overlapping dockets, schedule clashes force repeated requests for adjournment. Each granted adjournment prolongs the case lifecycle, further inflating the active caseload.

title: The Evasion, Escalation & Police Overburden Loop
path: Accused non-appearance → Proceedings frustrated → Magistrate escalates → Severity of warrants rises → Burden on police rises → Warrant execution drops → Accused traced drops → Non-appearance worsens
mechanism: Accused non-appearance forces courts to escalate from summons to non-bailable warrants. However, local police face severe bandwidth constraints. A surge in unexecuted warrants dilutes enforcement capacity, reducing execution rates and emboldening defendants to evade court dates.

title: The Litigation Fatigue & Attrition Loop
path: Case pendency rises → Money spent on case rises → Willingness to continue drops → Discounted settlements or withdrawals rise → Cases closed without recovery rises
mechanism: Prolonged delays impose severe financial and psychological burdens on complainants, eroding their persistence and forcing unrecovered abandonment or distress settlements.

title: The External Diversion / Mediation Balancing Loop
path: Caseload backlog rises (+) → Cases referred to mediation rises (+) → Dispute resolution (Lok Adalat / Mediation) rises (+) → Caseload backlog drops (-)
mechanism: As judicial pendency surges beyond operational capacity, magistrates actively divert check bounce disputes into alternative dispute resolution (ADR) mechanisms like Lok Adalats or mediation. Successful resolutions bleed off caseload volume, restoring courtroom bandwidth.

title: Judicial Clearance Pressure Balancing Loop
path: Caseload backlog rises (+) → Pressure to clear cases rises (+) → Cases reaching judgment rises (+) → Resolution through court rises (+) → Backlog drops (-)
mechanism: Rising pending figures trigger administrative scrutiny, disposal quotas, and judicial pressure, incentivizing judges to clamp down on frivolous adjournment requests and push older matters to final judgment.

title: The Non-Appearance Escalation Balancing Loop
path: Accused non-appearance (-) → Severity of warrants rises (+) → Police effort in pursuit rises (+) → Warrant execution rises (+) → Accused traced / appears rises (+)
mechanism: The legal framework counters defendant non-appearance through coercive procedural escalation (summons → bailable warrants → non-bailable warrants → custody/surety forfeiture), ultimately compelling court production to prevent indefinite stalemate.
